card.summary: a shared Linux account on Ubuntu with tilde tools, mail, gemini and gopher; the site's own news states SSH access is currently disabled after a root compromise

free_tier.stated: a shared Linux account on Ubuntu with tilde tools, mail, gemini and gopher; the site's own news states SSH access is currently disabled after a root compromise
free_tier.notes: no quota is published on the pages read

retention.stated: the host was rebuilt after 'rm -rf /'; the site says daily backups of the VM were taken, so 'we lost at most a couple hours of files'
retention.notes: this is a recovery statement, not a retention policy

egress.terms: not published on the pages read

record.interface_detail: inferred from the tooling the provider documents; not probed
record.limits_note: The account is approved by a human who reads the statement of interest, and the host it lands on is mid-rebuild after a root compromise, so the first thing that fails is the operator's availability rather than any quota.
record.binding_note: the binding constraint is availability, not a quota: SSH is disabled as of the August 2026 news post.

identity_cost.detail: signup at tilde.team/signup, which the site describes as a script the admins run to make accounts. The form fields were not read; no card or phone appears on the pages read.

evidence.proved: 'tilde.team got hacked. Someone was able to gain a root shell and ran rm -rf /', 'ssh access is currently disabled in the meantime', 'I'm still evaluating what to do with IRC, XMPP, email, nextcloud, and a few others', quoted; the item is dated August 2026
A listening sshd is not the same as an enabled user host and the news page says the user host is disabled [receipt: ssh://tilde.team:22]

signup asks for a username, an email, a statement of interest and an SSH public key, with 'you must be at least 13 years or older' and 'do NOT use temporary or forwarding email services to signup', quoted
quoted: 'tilde.team got hacked. Someone was able to gain a root shell and ran `rm -rf /`.' and 'ssh access is currently disabled in the meantime.'

record.notes: Tilde.team public access Unix system has suspended new public shell account registrations while maintenance is underway.

session_cap.note: shell access disabled at the time of reading

record.confidence_note: the outage and the disabled SSH are quoted from the site's own news post read. The quota is not published anywhere read, so it is absent rather than estimated.
